statement.domain: Any fixed closed smooth surface, orientable or not
statement.target: Smooth uniformly elliptic h_z, with no parameter regularity and no uncontrolled high-jet bound
statement.accuracy_order_N: A finite integer N > 20*mu+1; mu dominates a finite list of positive-power inequalities proved in theorem.md Sections 5-6
statement.constant_independence: N depends on displayed exponents and fixed background data, not implicit family constants or higher true-input norms
statement.conclusion: For sufficiently small z, gamma(fhat_z)=h_z and ||fhat_z-f_z||C2 <= z^L

jacobian.scope: A bounded order-four moment-system instance, not the all-order smoothing proof

lean.scope: Universal scalar finite waiting, persistence, the increment exponent margin, and bilinear transfer algebra only

not_certified: A full Lean formalization of the analytic theorem
